run_print_env: run the print_env script to dump Python, transformers, and PyTorch environment information
run_check_cuda_info: run the script to check CUDA version, CuDNN version, GPU count, and NCCL version
run_check_xpu_info: run the script to check SYCL version and XPU device count for Intel XPU accelerators
run_check_hpu_info: run the script to check HPU version and device count for Habana Gaudi accelerators
run_check_deepspeed_ffmpeg: run the script to check DeepSpeed and FFmpeg library versions available in the environment
